_doc: T-3684: today's street names in data/context/1871/modern_clip.json carried to their 1871 names, read by tools in generators/city_1871_emit.py. Each rule names the evidence. Rules are tried in order; 'where' limits a rule to segments whose midpoint lies in the given local e/n ranges. name null = no 1871 street is drawn on this line (basis later/made_land) or its 1871 name could not be read (basis unread: drawn, unnamed). The emitter adds the division prefix the 1871 directory uses (West Lake Street, North Clark Street, South Canal Street).

edwards_1871.means: the 1871 directory prints the name (records in chicago/pre_fire_v1/data/field_notebook_1871.json)

mitchell_1870.means: lettered on the 1870 map at this line, read through the map_control affine

plat.means: the plat name, unchanged, on a line the 1870 map draws

unread.means: the 1870 map draws a street here; its name is not legible at the scan's resolution

made_land.means: on made land east of the 1871 shore or later park ground; not drawn

city_limits_1869.means: named on the 1869 city-limits diagram, beyond the 1870 map's sheet

reuben_street___ashland_avenue.note: the 1870 map letters this line 'Reuben' and 'N. Reuben' along its length; Ashland is its later name

egan_avenue.name: Egan Avenue
egan_avenue.note: Thirty-ninth Street is its later name
